node.statement: By bilinearity and U bold-dot R=J, U bold-dot U^dagger-J=U bold-dot (U^dagger-R). The product-norm axiom, followed by the two preceding local estimates, gives ||U bold-dot U^dagger-J||<=(1+epsilon_r)*||U||*||U^dagger-R||<=(1+epsilon_r)*||U||*epsilon_r*||U||^2*||R||<=(17/16)*(4/3)*(16/9)*(3/2)*epsilon_r=(34/9)*epsilon_r<=4*epsilon_r. This uses only bilinearity, the product-norm axiom, and the single associator estimate in the preceding child.
